statement: Worship guide is multi-part; this part covers the Soul game, Tower Defense comes in a later video.
Worship is a World 3 skill; you use charge at a totem or the easy access totem from construction.
Wizard is the best class for the Soul game thanks to the charge siphon talent.
Charge siphon steals charge from all other players to greatly increase max charge so you collect souls on the wizard instead of each character.
Check charge speed and current charge in inventory skill info under worship; charge cap depends on the skull (worship tool) and other buffs.
Buy bigger charge buffs from the first skull in the World 3 shop.
Get all characters high in worship so the charge siphon wizard gets even more charge.
Forest Soul is the Goblin Gorefest totem in forest outskirts (goblins map) and costs 25 charge.
Dune Souls is the Waka Waka War totem at up down (moonman map) for 40 charge.
Rooted Souls is the Acorn Assault totem at the roots (bottom right portal of walking sticks map) for 60 charge.
Frigid Soul is the Frosty Firefight totem at rolling tundra (snowman map) for 90 charge.
Squishy Souls is the Clash of Cans totem at mountainous dew (cans map) for 120 charge.
Uzi Soul is the new Citric Conflict totem at OJ Bay (citroen map) costing 250 charge.
Reaching a certain level in automation arm unlocks the easy totem at the top of World 3 town map.
Easy totem lets you worship only after completing over wave 10 of Tower Defense.
Easy totem means you don't need much carry capacity since you can run up and down from storage.
Get the easy totem as soon as possible.
Use up full charge on a skull before swapping to a new skull or you lose that skull's charge.
Highest wave in Tower Defense increases soul gain.
Skill efficiency gives extra soul bonuses and wizard as the specialized class gets massive bonuses.
Soul bonus from efficiency steps start at 60 then 250 1000 3000 and 8000.
Easiest efficiency bonus is wisdom; higher wisdom means higher efficiency.
Star sign Praise Be? in hydron gives 15 worship efficiency and 15 worship XP.
Creator statue? gives worship power which is the skill equivalent of weapon power.
Worship ovals? give worship power and wisdom things help charge and max charge.
Charge rate and max charge matter especially if you are chilling in lab and Divinity.
Frigid Soul and Squishy cards give max charge and charge rate.
Flowin stamp gives charging speed.
Ray the Crater gives max charge.
Call Me Pope in the purple cauldron boosts worship charge and max charge and is very strong so equip it.
Small purple bubble 10 Gospel Leader gives max charge per 10 worship levels.
Purple bubbles 2 and 14 passive multipliers also work for Gospel Leader.
Get as much spice as possible for the skilling food Soluble Gum.
Use soluble gum on a big charge dump; can give over 50 extra souls based on food effect percent.
Soul card setup: Chaotic Troll Squishy Soul Frigid Soul Chaotic Efaunt? Crabcake so you consume less food; add wisdom cards.
For card set choose Yum Desert or Easy Resources since AFK does not affect soul gain.
Big soul gain realistically can be done about once every two to three days.
Unlocking specific prayers requires reaching certain Tower Defense waves.
Jawbreaker requires wave 101 in Waka Waka War.
Prayers are tricky because you don't know how much to level them given bonus versus curse.
Skill Dimwit? unlocks at wave 25 Goblin Gorefest; max it out since the XP loss is only 1.18x additive.
Don't use skill XP-reducing prayer when using balloons.
Unending Energy unlocks at wave 51 Goblin Gorefest and is amazing to eventually max because the curse doesn't scale with level.
Shiny Snitch wave 81 Goblin is a trapping staple but dangerous to level due to high shiny chance.
Prayer at wave 121 Goblin Gorefest is a no-brainer to max for more AFK gains; only costs a little carry capacity.
Midas Mind wave 71 Waka Waka is good to max.
Mob health increaser curse doesn't work on bosses including mini bosses so boss farming gets free extra drop rate.
Royal Sampler wave 21 Acorn Assault is up in the air; run it if you want 3D printer percent maxed at 90.
Circular Criticals wave 71 Acorn Assault is best around 20 percent max but can max out if needing 200 crit chance.
Balance of Pain wave 21 Clash of Cans: max it since late game accuracy and defense are easy and more multikill per tier.
Rest of the prayers can be leveled at your leisure.
Wizard skilling build talents: smart efficiency souls wisdom and charge siphon.
Before big soul gain equip skilling build cards and card sets and soluble gum.
Equipment: serrated rex rings king of food trophy or idle skiller.
Go to World 3 use charge siphon and spam tap like Cookie Clicker not an auto clicker.
Take skilling balloons into Tower Defense to increase worship level; good for leveling non-wizard characters.
